silhouette.reason: Torpedo body, tall notched first dorsal, crescent caudal, pectorals and gill slits read as a great white in every view.
fixes: lengthen the lower caudal lobe so the tail is closer to lunate in SIDE

proportions.reason: 4.5 m with sourced girth and fin positions; the pectorals are still paper-thin lines in FRONT and the snout is a touch pointed.
fixes: give the pectorals a root thickness (~6 % of chord) tapering to the edge

materials.reason: Countershaded grey over white with a ragged boundary, speckled skin and pores read as shark skin; the eye is a plain black ball and the skin is one uniform satin.
fixes: an eyelid rim and pupil ring on the eye
slight roughness variation over the flank (denticle micro-normal)

detail.reason: Gill slits, tooth row, snout pores, scars, second dorsal and pelvic fins at hero distance; fin edges are not darkened and there are no caudal keels.
fixes: dark pectoral tips and trailing edges
caudal keels and a lateral line

wear.reason: A torn notch in the first dorsal and pale scratch scars on the back tell a fighting history.
fixes: parasitic copepods or a healed bite on a fin

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps outline, fins and the white belly; LOD1 at 12.7k now keeps fins and gills.
fixes: keep the ragged countershading boundary at LOD2 instead of a straight edge

technical.reason: 64.8k / 12.7k / 716 triangles, one draw; triangles sit in the head and fins where they show.
fixes: move some uniform mid-body density into fin thickness
